research_slices.title: Reconcile signed-artifact legacy preimage and new canonical profile
research_slices.problem: Current artifact documentation describes a domain-separated/length-prefixed preimage, but audited implementation hashes serialized SignedBody bytes directly. New profile design must not silently change existing signatures.
scope: Compare audited docs and implementation byte-for-byte
Record serde serialization profile/version and actual legacy verification vectors
Specify separate deterministic-CBOR Body/signature/envelope-ID profile and dual-reader transition
Do not re-sign or rewrite old history
research_slices.test_oracle: Independent Ed25519 verifier checks golden legacy bytes and new CBOR vectors; existing signed fixtures continue verifying unchanged; neither profile hashes its own identifier into its signed preimage.
done_criteria: Legacy source-level mismatch is resolved or explicitly documented with exact byte behavior
Versioned profile table and compatibility vectors are reviewed
Migration/downgrade behavior is explicit and forbids silent re-sign/rehash

research_slices.title: Trace Atlas content_hash production and define exact producer contract
research_slices.trigger: Before any Atlas content_hash interoperability claim, or when the external production pipeline is located.
research_slices.problem: Checked-in Atlas schema and search consumers use content_hash but the audited checkout has no production producer; fixtures do not establish exact source bytes or a profile.
scope: Locate and pin actual producer pipeline, if any
Specify exact source bytes, normalization, algorithm/profile/version and file/chunk semantics
Record a known-answer vector and independent recomputation oracle
If producer is external/unavailable, state that explicitly and block interop claims
research_slices.test_oracle: Independent bytes-to-ContentId implementation matches a producer-generated known-answer vector; consumer join resolves the expected chunk. If no producer can be reached, the decisive oracle is a documented no-interoperability status and absence of inferred hash claims.
done_criteria: Producer provenance and pinned revision recorded or confirmed absent
Exact bytes/profile and test vector defined or explicitly left unknown
Cross-system use blocked until this contract passes
